name: FFS_ST_MATRIX_DATA
description: Contains data for travel statistics matrices.

columns.name: ACTIVITY_FROM_KEY_ID
columns.description: Activity Travel Key ID of the source (Activity or Provider location).

columns.name: ACTIVITY_TO_KEY_ID
columns.description: Activity Travel Key ID of the target (Activity or Provider location).

columns.name: AVG
columns.description: Average travel time between ACTIVITY_FROM_KEY_ID and ACTIVITY_TO_KEY_ID in minutes.

columns.name: SIGMA2
columns.description: Squared deviation from average travel time.

columns.name: COUNT
columns.description: Number (sum of weights) of averaged samples in category.

columns.name: ORIGIN
columns.description: Defines the method that was used create this record.

columns.name: CREATED_BY
columns.description: Who column: indicates the user who created the row.

columns.name: CREATION_DATE
columns.description: Who column: indicates the date and time of the creation of the row.

columns.name: LAST_UPDATED_BY
columns.description: Who column: indicates the user who last updated the row.

columns.name: LAST_UPDATE_DATE
columns.description: Who column: indicates the date and time of the last update of the row.

columns.name: LAST_UPDATE_LOGIN
columns.description: Who column: indicates the session login associated to the user who last updated the row.
